# SpawnForge

> AI-Powered Game Creation Platform

SpawnForge is a browser-based 2D and 3D game engine that lets anyone create, edit, and publish games using natural language and a visual editor. No downloads, no installs — describe your game and watch it come to life. Built on a production-grade Rust/WASM engine with WebGPU rendering and WebGL2 fallback.

## Key Capabilities

- AI-first game creation from natural language prompts
- 2D and 3D game engine (Rust compiled to WASM)
- WebGPU primary rendering with WebGL2 fallback
- Visual scripting (73 node types) and TypeScript scripting
- 383 MCP commands for AI-assisted editing across 41 categories (external MCP clients work against a local build; hosted access is coming after launch)
- Real-time physics simulation (Rapier 3D and 2D)
- AI asset generation with your own provider API keys (BYOK): 3D models, textures, audio, music, voice. Platform-provided generation is coming after launch
- One-click browser game publishing
- PBR materials (56 presets), skeletal animation, GPU particles
- Tilemap editor, dialogue system, economy designer, leaderboards

## Pricing

- Free: $0/month — full editor and local export, 3 cloud projects, 1 published game, 50 trial AI tokens at signup
- Starter: $9/month — 10 cloud projects, 3 published games, 300 AI tokens/month, AI chat, bring-your-own-key asset generation
- Creator: $29/month — 50 cloud projects, 10 published games, 1,000 AI tokens/month, advanced AI panels (external MCP access coming after launch)
- Studio: $79/month — unlimited cloud projects, 100 published games, 3,000 AI tokens/month, Pro AI panels (platform AI keys coming after launch)
